en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.

zh: 非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。

p.src: 1  Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

en: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
u.src: 1  Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

p.src: 2  My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

en: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
u.src: 2  My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

p.src: 3  When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

en: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
u.src: 3  When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

p.src: 4  In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

en: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
u.src: 4  In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

p.src: 5  All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

en: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
u.src: 5  All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

p.src: 6  They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

en: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
u.src: 6  They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

p.src: 7  Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

en: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
u.src: 7  Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

p.src: 8  You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

en: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
u.src: 8  You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

p.src: 9  Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

en: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
u.src: 9  Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

p.src: 10  In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

en: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.
u.src: 10  In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

p.src: 11  I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

en: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
u.src: 11  I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

p.src: 12  Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

en: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
u.src: 12  Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

p.src: 13  For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

en: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
u.src: 13  For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
